items.name: support-widget
items.title: Support Widget
items.description: Docked support chat with home, messages and conversation views: kai-panel chrome, kai-tab-bar navigation, kai-view-stack routing and the headless conversation controller over local storage. Ships with a scripted mock so the thread demos reasoning and a tool call on first paint.
items.docs: Runs against a scripted local mock out of the box - no endpoint, no key. To go live, replace the mock responder in support-widget.js with a fetch to your chat endpoint and keep parsing through the @kitn.ai/ui/wire readers.
